profile.name: Tomide Williams
profile.title: AI Product Marketing Manager & AI Growth Engineer
profile.tagline: I build AI voice agents, sales agents, marketing agents, and full-stack apps, then use them to drive real revenue growth.
profile.bio: I help businesses stop losing money to slow follow-up, missed calls, and manual work. I design go-to-market strategy and build the AI systems that run it, voice agents, chatbots, and CRM automation built with Claude Code, n8n, GoHighLevel, and ElevenLabs. The result is the same: leads get a fast answer, deals keep moving, and your team spends its time on work that needs a person. I have done this across AI, EdTech, SaaS, and HR-tech, and I bring both the marketing thinking and the hands-on building, so the strategy and the system are never out of sync.

projects.title: AI Sales Agents
projects.shortDescription: Qualify leads, follow up, update your CRM, and keep deals moving, without a single lead going cold because someone was busy.
brief: Sales teams lose momentum when they have to chase unqualified leads or manually log every touchpoint into a CRM.
Every minute spent on manual follow-up or data entry is a minute taken away from closing deals.
We needed a way to automate the top of the funnel so human reps only step in when a prospect is ready to talk.

implementation.title: Automated Lead Qualification
implementation.detail: Deployed an AI agent to instantly engage inbound leads, ask qualifying questions, and score them based on fit.

implementation.title: Persistent Follow-Up
implementation.detail: Set up autonomous follow-up sequences across email and SMS that adapt based on prospect engagement.

implementation.title: CRM Syncing
implementation.detail: Integrated directly with the CRM to log all conversations, update lead statuses, and schedule follow-up tasks without manual data entry.

before: Leads often went cold because sales reps were too busy to follow up instantly.
Hours were wasted manually updating the CRM after every interaction.
Reps spent most of their time talking to unqualified prospects instead of closing deals.
after: Every inbound lead gets an instant, personalized response and qualification.
The CRM updates itself automatically based on the AI's conversations.
Human sales reps only talk to warm, qualified leads who are ready to buy.
whyThisApproach: Speed to lead is the most critical factor in sales conversion.
An AI agent can respond in seconds, 24/7, ensuring no opportunity is missed while keeping the human touch for the final close.

impact.headline: Zero leads dropped, instant qualification, and automated CRM hygiene.
benefits: No more leads falling through the cracks.
Sales reps focus entirely on selling.

projects.title: AI Customer Support Agents
projects.shortDescription: Answer the questions customers keep asking, fix the simple issues, and only hand it to a person when it truly needs one.
brief: Support teams are often overwhelmed by the same repetitive questions, leaving less time for complex issues.
Customers expect instant answers, but scaling human support 24/7 is cost-prohibitive.
We needed an intelligent layer to handle the bulk of inquiries while seamlessly routing complex tickets to humans.

implementation.title: Knowledge Base Integration
implementation.detail: Trained the AI on the company's specific documentation, past tickets, and FAQs to ensure accurate answers.

implementation.title: Resolution Workflows
implementation.detail: Built automated flows for common actions like password resets, order tracking, and basic troubleshooting.

implementation.title: Smart Handoff
implementation.detail: Implemented sentiment analysis and complexity scoring to instantly route frustrated users or complex issues to human agents.

before: Support agents spent 70% of their day answering the same five questions.
Customers waited hours for simple answers.
High volume meant human agents rushed through complex issues.
after: The AI handles up to 80% of routine inquiries instantly, 24/7.
Human agents have the time to provide white-glove support for complex issues.
Customer satisfaction scores improved due to zero wait times for simple fixes.
whyThisApproach: Customers don't want to talk to a human; they want their problem solved quickly.
By resolving the simple issues automatically, we improve the customer experience while drastically reducing support costs.

impact.headline: Instant resolution for routine tickets and protected time for complex support.
benefits: Zero wait time for common questions.

projects.title: AI Operations Agents
projects.shortDescription: Handle the internal work that eats your team's time: reporting, data, coordination, and documentation.
brief: Behind every business is a mountain of invisible work: formatting reports, moving data between systems, and chasing updates.
This administrative overhead drains momentum and keeps talented people doing robotic tasks.
We built operations agents to act as invisible coordinators, handling the connective tissue of the business.

implementation.title: Data Aggregation
implementation.detail: Set up agents to automatically pull data from multiple disconnected systems into unified reports.

implementation.title: Workflow Orchestration
implementation.detail: Built rules-based agents to trigger next steps in a process, assign tasks, and follow up on deadlines.

implementation.title: Automated Documentation
implementation.detail: Created systems that watch project updates and automatically generate summaries, changelogs, and client reports.

before: Team members spent hours every week manually compiling data for weekly meetings.
Tasks stalled because someone forgot to notify the next person in the chain.
Documentation was always out of date.
after: Reports generate themselves before the meeting starts.
Handoffs between team members happen automatically.
Documentation stays current without manual intervention.
whyThisApproach: Operations should be invisible. When teams have to manually manage their processes, they aren't doing the work they were hired for.
AI agents are perfectly suited for repetitive, data-heavy coordination.

impact.headline: Eliminated the administrative friction that slows teams down.
benefits: Frees up team capacity for deep work.
Ensures processes run consistently every time.

projects.title: Marketing & Outreach Agents
projects.shortDescription: Write drafts, personalise outreach, and run campaigns across every platform, without the manual grind.
brief: Personalized marketing works, but doing it at scale is impossible without a massive team.
Generic blasts get ignored, but researching every prospect and drafting unique copy takes too long.
We needed an engine that could produce highly personalized, researched content and outreach at scale.

implementation.title: Deep Research
implementation.detail: Deployed agents to scrape prospect data, company news, and LinkedIn profiles to find relevant hooks.

implementation.title: Content Generation
implementation.detail: Built prompts that generate first drafts of emails, social posts, and ad copy matching the brand's exact voice.

implementation.title: Campaign Execution
implementation.detail: Wired the generated content directly into sending platforms and ad managers for seamless execution.

before: Outreach was either highly personalized but low volume, or high volume but completely generic.
Creating a month of social content took a full week of drafting and approval.
after: Thousands of prospects receive emails that look like they were hand-researched for hours.
Content calendars are filled with high-quality, on-brand drafts in minutes.
Campaigns launch faster with more variants to test.
whyThisApproach: The bottleneck in marketing is production. AI solves the production bottleneck while allowing humans to maintain strategic control.
Deep personalization at scale is the only way to cut through the noise.

impact.headline: Hyper-personalized marketing campaigns executed at the speed of automation.
benefits: Maintain a consistent, active brand presence.
Test more angles and ideas quickly.

projects.title: Custom Internal AI Agents
projects.shortDescription: Built around your specific systems, your data, and the way your business actually works, not a template.
brief: Off-the-shelf AI tools are great, but they don't know your proprietary processes or how your specific systems connect.
Generic AI requires you to change how you work to fit the tool.
We build bespoke agents that adapt to your business, securely accessing your private data to solve unique operational bottlenecks.

implementation.title: Process Mapping
implementation.detail: Mapped the exact, unique workflows of the business to identify where AI could replace manual effort.

implementation.title: Secure Integration
implementation.detail: Connected large language models securely to proprietary databases, ERPs, and internal tools via custom APIs.

implementation.title: Tailored Logic
implementation.detail: Built specific decision trees and guardrails to ensure the agent follows the company's strict operational rules.

before: Complex, company-specific tasks relied entirely on tribal knowledge and manual execution.
Off-the-shelf AI tools couldn't access internal databases or follow bespoke compliance rules.
after: A custom agent handles complex internal workflows exactly as a trained employee would.
Proprietary data is leveraged securely without leaving the company's ecosystem.
Tribal knowledge is encoded into a reliable, automated system.
whyThisApproach: True operational efficiency comes from automating the processes that make your business unique, not just the generic ones.
A custom build ensures the AI respects your security, data, and exact business logic.

impact.headline: A bespoke AI workforce built specifically for your unique operational DNA.
benefits: Fits your business; you don't fit it.
Unlocks the value of proprietary data.

projects.title: AI Voice Agents
projects.shortDescription: Answer and place real phone calls to schedule appointments, qualify leads, and handle tier-one support automatically.
brief: Phone calls are the most urgent form of communication, but staffing phones 24/7 is impossible for most businesses.
Missed calls mean missed revenue, and robotic IVR phone menus frustrate callers.
We deployed conversational AI voice agents that sound human, understand context, and can actually execute tasks over the phone.

implementation.title: Conversational Design
implementation.detail: Built natural-sounding dialogue flows that handle interruptions, tangents, and accents gracefully.

implementation.title: System Connectivity
implementation.detail: Wired the voice agent into the calendar and CRM so it can physically book appointments and update records during the call.

implementation.title: Inbound & Outbound
implementation.detail: Set up the agent to instantly answer all inbound calls and run massive outbound dialing campaigns for lead reactivation.

before: After-hours calls went to voicemail and were often ignored by prospects.
Receptionists spent hours making outbound confirmation calls.
Call spikes resulted in long hold times and abandoned leads.
after: Every call is answered instantly by a friendly, intelligent voice agent, 24/7.
Appointments are booked and confirmed on the calendar without human intervention.
Outbound campaigns can dial thousands of leads in minutes.
whyThisApproach: Voice is still the highest-converting channel, but it's the hardest to scale.
Modern voice AI is finally fast and natural enough to provide a great customer experience while massively scaling capacity.

impact.headline: A 24/7 conversational voice team that never misses a call, never takes a break, and scales infinitely.
